name: IGLOO VR
summary:
**Igloo VR is a 3D model review platform for architecture and design teams.** Upload a model from Rhino or SketchUp and open it in VR, with no manual conversion required.

A model on a monitor never tells you how a space actually feels. In Igloo VR you walk through your design at 1:1 scale and judge ceiling heights, openings, and circulation with your own body.
